reason: The README describes a plugin centered on a Web UI dashboard for visualizing persisted model token usage, trends, per-model statistics, and pricing, with local history synchronization and configurable pricing feeds.

summaries.zh: 在 Web 设置页面中记录并可视化模型请求的 Token 用量、趋势、模型明细和估算费用。
summaries.en: Records and visualizes model request token usage, trends, per-model details, and estimated costs in a Web settings page.

capabilities: Records per-request model token usage and session metadata locally
Displays token totals, trends, model breakdowns, and calculated costs in a web settings page
Synchronizes historical request records on startup
Fetches model pricing data from a configured remote mirror
Writes, migrates, and removes files within the configured token-usage data directory
